mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a tightening monetary policy cycle that raises real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL MoM change > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS MoM change > 0.1%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL MoM change > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS MoM change > 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to elevated recession risks and profit-taking as the economic cycle peaks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 750,000 units indicates a contraction in the residential construction sector, which reduces household wealth and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 750.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high levels of industrial production (INDPRO > 98.0) and consumer spending (RSAFS > 400000.0) signal an overheating economy that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 98.0 and RSAFS > 400000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 230.0 signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls below 130,000 thousand signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces household income and consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 130000.0.
